featured_reviews.review_text: At the outset, I must say Shadab Khan the owner is a very nice person to deal with. They did an excellent job in replacing the fabric of our sofa set.  Their work has been flawless and timely.  They deserve a 5 star rating.  My best wishes to them.

featured_reviews.name: Raghavendran LakshmiNarayanan
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently had my sofa reupholstered, and I couldn't be happier with the results. From start to finish, the experience was seamless. The team was incredibly prompt, managing to complete the job much earlier than anticipated, which was a pleasant surprise. They offered a fair and transparent price, with no hidden costs, making the entire process stress-free.

What really stood out was their impeccable attention to detail. Every stitch and seam was done to perfection, and the finishing touches were top-class. It's clear they take immense pride in their work. The final product exceeded my expectations—my sofa looks and feels like it's brand new again!

If you're looking for a reliable, skilled, and reasonably priced upholstery service, I highly recommend them. Their professionalism and craftsmanship are truly second to none.

featured_reviews.name: Sunflower
featured_reviews.review_text:
My sofa set needed urgent refurbishment but since I live abroad, I was prepared that it was going to be a daunting task to manage things remotely.
But Salman made the process simple and super quick. He is professional, economical and has a versatile catalogue of offerings. In 5 days flat, my old sagging sofas were made brand new and given a new lease of life. I recommend him

featured_reviews.name: Siddharth Agarwal
featured_reviews.review_text: One stop solution for custom made sofas & sofa repairs. I recently availed their sofa repair service at my home & the outcome was wonderful & worth sharing. The well experienced serviceman was knowledgeable & delivered more than my expectations. Reported ontime & finished the work before the shared deadline, the pricing too was reasonable since you are directly dealing with the craftsman & no middle man involved. Certainly worth recommending.
